anomalies.observed: C12 is a capacitor (libsource part "C", description "Unpolarized capacitor", value "0.1uF") but its Footprint field is "Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder" — an inductor land pattern. In addition, C12 pin 1 sits on the single-node net "unconnected-(C12-Pad1)" (a plain passive pin with no no_connect flag) while only C12 pin 2 is on GND, so the capacitor is open on one side.
anomalies.expected: A decoupling/bypass capacitor must use a capacitor footprint (e.g. Capacitor_SMD:C_0805...) and have both terminals connected — one to the rail it bypasses, the other to GND. A capacitor in an inductor footprint with a floating terminal serves no purpose.
anomalies.impact: C12 is electrically dead (connected only to GND, other terminal open), so whatever bypass/decoupling it was intended to provide on the EthernetAndPower sheet is absent; a capacitor is also placed in an inductor land pattern.

anomalies.observed: SKW92A pins 13 and 14 (LAN_PORT3_TX+ and LAN_PORT3_TX-) are both placed on the GND net, while the module's other unused EPHY pins (WAN_PORT_RX+/TX+/- on pins 1-4) are left as single-node unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: Unused EPHY/GPIO pins should be left unconnected or used for a function; shorting differential transmit pins directly to ground is not normal practice and creates contention if the pin is ever driven. At minimum this is inconsistent with the treatment of the other unused EPHY pins, which are left floating.
anomalies.impact: If the SKW92A firmware ever drives these LAN3 transmit lines they are hard-shorted to ground (contention / possible pin damage); if they stay unused the effect is nil, but the connection is still a deviation from the rest of the unused-pin handling.

parsed.summary: The build contains a clear defect: C12 is a capacitor that carries an inductor footprint and has one terminal floating on "unconnected-(C12-Pad1)" (only the other terminal reaches GND), so it is a dead component; a secondary, lower-confidence concern is that SKW92A pins 13/14 (LAN_PORT3_TX+/-) are shorted to GND while the other unused EPHY pins are left open.
